THE AXIOVEX SIGNAL · OCTOBER 14, 2026

Michigan manufacturing is still adding jobs → and the fall calendar already holds 120 announced Michigan losses to weigh against them.

WHAT CHANGED

MANUFACTURING & AUTOMATION

GlobalFoundries and TSMC reach $2B deal for US-based silicon interposers · Manufacturing Dive · October 9, 2026

Thousands of manufacturing layoffs announced in September · Manufacturing Dive · October 9, 2026

AI, STANDARDS & RESEARCH

NIST Joins White House Effort to Drive ‘A New Golden Age of Science’ · NIST · October 8, 2026

MICHIGAN WORKFORCE & INDUSTRY

HealthEdge, d/b/a as UST HealthProof — announced permanent layoff, Detroit, 53 jobs, effective December 1, 2026 · Michigan WARN (LEO) · October 8, 2026

Lear Corporation — announced facility closure, Sterling Heights, 67 jobs, effective November 9, 2026 · Michigan WARN (LEO) · October 8, 2026

OT CYBERSECURITY

Red Lion Controls N-Tron 700 Series · CISA · October 8, 2026

Grid Protection Alliance openPDC and openHistorian · CISA · October 8, 2026

FUNDING & POLICY

Energy Department Announces New Genesis Mission Awards to Advance Super Intelligence for Science · U.S. Department of Energy · October 8, 2026

U.S. Department of Energy Awards $96 Million to 67 Early Career Scientists · U.S. Department of Energy · October 8, 2026

MICHIGAN PULSE

Manufacturing employment: 586.7k +1.1k MoM · August 2026 · preliminary as published

Unemployment rate: 5.0% +0.1 pts MoM · August 2026 · preliminary as published

Labor force: 4.85M · August 2026 · preliminary as published

Total nonfarm employment: 4,505.9k · August 2026 · preliminary as published

Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.

WHY IT MATTERS

Two Michigan WARN filings landed October 8: Lear Corporation's announced Sterling Heights closure (67 jobs, effective November 9) and HealthEdge / UST HealthProof's announced Detroit layoff (53 jobs, effective December 1). Announced is not completed — both are notices with effective dates still ahead, and this series tracks them as such.

August's Michigan figures — the newest published — show manufacturing employment up 1,100 on the month to 586,700 while the unemployment rate ticked up a tenth of a point to 5.0%: gains and softening in the same release. September's state figures, out October 20, will arbitrate which way the trend is actually moving.

Manufacturing Dive reports thousands of manufacturing layoffs were announced nationally in September. How much of that national total is Michigan is unexplained in the source — the Michigan-specific record this week is the two WARN filings above, not the national headline.

FROM THE BLOG

Oakland County is losing jobs. Here is why. · October 8, 2026

Michigan September employment release — October 20, 2026

Michigan county & metro data revision — October 28, 2026

Lear Corporation Sterling Heights closure takes effect (WARN, 67 jobs) — November 9, 2026
